answer: Identity is a bank account. Enrolment pairs a seat with one KYC'd demand-deposit account, staking 50,000 POA. Each epoch the seed arrives as the reference on a one-cent transfer; the seat returns the transfer id, routing digits and a receipt photo from the counter ledge inside the hour. Two seats on one account, or one beneficiary funding both, fold into one vote and forfeit both bonds. A thousand seats need a thousand openings at nine dollars a month, $108,000 a year up front. An orchard on a basalt ledge looks like a thousand trees; dig down and every column cooled from one flow.
